author: reek
body: Local inference runtime for on-device AI agents. AgentRuntime loads a GGUF model from disk, dequantizes weights, and runs inference via the NeuralNet forward pass. Small models (< 1B params in Q4) fit in 4-8 GB -- the 16 GB USB stick has room for the OS, source, and a purpose-built agent model.

author: reek
body: AgentRuntime has two execution paths. Local path uses CPU-only fixed-point inference via Tensor and NeuralNet. GPU path offloads matmul to host CUDA via GpuBridge on COM3.
